claims.text: Dashboard overview
claims.note: Tile title. The Spatial Adjust module has one routed view, the dashboard (spatial-adjust-routing.module.ts:15), laid out as map, chart and table under the toolbar.

claims.text: The four regions of the screen and what each one is telling you.
claims.note: Tile summary. The four regions are the toolbar, the map, the chart and the table. On screens 1400 px wide or narrower the layout stacks and the chart is hidden (sa-dashboard.component.less:91-103), so most tablets show three regions. That caveat is carried in the correction for dashboard-overview/3/2.

claims.text: The whole feature lives on one screen.
claims.note: The module routes to one view, the dashboard (the demo child route aside). Push, settings and the other tools open as dialogs over it (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:94-112).

claims.text: Learn what each of the four regions tells you, and which numbers are measured versus calculated.
claims.note: Measured versus calculated is shown in the table: a station not scanned today is estimated under Option 2 (spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:184-188) and drawn grey and italic with a calculator icon (sa-table-card.component.html:29-32).

claims.text: /spatialadjust
claims.note: Retyped from behaviour to navigation. The root router's path is 'spatialadjust', guarded by SpatialAdjustGuardService.

claims.text: You need a Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 (introduction, before Settings Configuration) says sites that subscribe reach Spatial Adjust by logging into IntelliDash and using the Spatial Adjust button, and to contact NSN if the link is missing. In code the route guard requires a Spatial Adjust user, meaning the user's spatialAdjust flag plus a TurfRad id (spatial-adjust-manager.service.ts:185-189), and the data load returns only areas, holes and stations that have scans (SpatialAdjustService.cs:180-211).

claims.text: Without recent scans the map and table are empty.
claims.note: Scans are requested from TurfRad for the last seven days (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2510), and only areas, holes and stations with scans are returned (:180-211). With none, map and table both show STRINGS.NO_DATA_TO_DISPLAY "No data to display" (sa-dashboard.component.html:3, :36). 373-1135 rev 02 §Table Functionality: the station view shows stations with scans in the past 7 days.

claims.text: The route is all lowercase — /spatialadjust. /spatialAdjust does not resolve and redirects to the error page.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to navigation, since the router settles it and 373-1135 rev 02 does not cover URLs. Angular matches route paths case-sensitively. 'spatialadjust' is the only path for the feature, and anything else falls through to the wildcard route, which redirects to /ah-snap, the generic error page.

claims.text: The view is desktop and tablet only; phones are turned away by the route guard.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; 373-1135 rev 02 does not cover device support, and the guard settles it. The route is admitted only when the device detector reports desktop or tablet, alongside the Spatial Adjust user check (spatial-adjust-guard.service.ts:22-26). Anyone else is sent to the IntelliDash home page (:33).

claims.text: Start with the toolbar
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: The left of the toolbar identifies where you are: site name, and a course selector that only appears when the site has more than one Lynx course.
claims.note: Site name at :8. The course dropdown renders only when the Lynx course list has more than one entry (:9, :11). 373-1135 rev 02 §Multiple Lynx Course Support describes the same dropdown.

claims.text: Next to it the weather strip shows current temperature, relative humidity, today’s ET and precipitation.
claims.note: The strip shows current temperature, relative humidity, the first daily ET value and precipitation, and opens an overlay with more detail. 373-1135 rev 02 §Header describes the same strip, from DTN weather for the site's location.

claims.text: It reports conditions; it is not where the suggested percentages come from.
claims.note: The strip's ET is the weather overlay's daily value (sa-weather-tb.component.html:6). The suggestion is computed on the server from the stored daily ET record (GetCurrentEtForOrgAsync, SpatialAdjustService.cs:2838-2882), and that figure is shown separately as Calculation ET above the table (sa-dashboard.component.html:33).

claims.text: Option 1 uses no ET at all, and Option 2’s figure is calculated before the page loads.
claims.note: Option 1 (Simple) is Target VWC ÷ measured VWC × the current Lynx percentage, with no ET (sa-algorithm.service.ts:58-60). Option 2 (DeltaPlusTodayEt, the default) looks up the value the server has already stored for the station (:62-65), computed when the server processes scan data (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2931-3043).
claims.developNote: On develop (bd39f465) the same arithmetic moves into CalculateAdjustment (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3211-3232), and a new pass writes today's adjustment from the carried-forward model on days with no new scan (:3280-3325). The Option 2 figure is still computed before the page reads it.

claims.text: Toolbar, left: site, course selector, weather strip and the course-wide moisture summary.
claims.note: Figure caption. The left-hand group holds the logo, site name, course selector, weather strip and the AVG. VWC / HIGH / LOW summary (:2-32); the right-hand group, #sa-tb-right (:33), holds Push Changes, Pushed Today and the tool buttons.

claims.text: Note. The average, high and low VWC figures summarise the areas of the selected course that were scanned today, whatever the table is showing.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/1/7); docs/text-corrections.md §24 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Note. Avg / High / Low moisture are computed across every station in the selected course, not just the ones visible in the table.

claims.text: Read the map
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/2/2); docs/text-corrections.md §23 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Every station is a pin coloured by its latest measured VWC against the four moisture bands in the legend.

claims.text: A pin scanned today is coloured by its measured VWC against the four moisture bands in the legend, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/2/2); docs/text-corrections.md §23 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Disabled stations stay hidden while Layers is set to Enabled Stations, the default.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/2/2); docs/text-corrections.md §23 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Drag the handles on the colour bar to move the band boundaries — the map recolours immediately and the change is saved to your user preferences.
claims.note: The map redraws when the handle is released: the colour bar emits dragEnd on mouse-up or touch-end (color-range.component.ts:79-87), the overlay passes the new bands to the map, whose setter redraws every pin (sa-dash-map.component.ts:138-143), and saves them to the signed-in user's dashboard preferences (sa-map-overlay.component.ts:120-132). While the handle moves, only the legend labels change (color-range.component.ts:115-139). "Immediately" holds if read as "on release"; map-navigation/2/3, which says "as you drag", is marked Wrong.

claims.text: Map with the moisture legend.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Bands default to 0–5, 6–19, 20–30 and above 30 percent.
claims.note: With no saved bands the boundaries fall back to 5, 19 and 30, which the legend labels 0-5%, 6-19%, 20-30% and > 30%.

claims.text: Variance view. The button beside the legend switches the pins from absolute moisture to variance — how far each station sits from its target rather than its raw reading.
claims.note: The button's tooltip is SPATIAL_ADJUST.TOGGLE_VWC_VARIANCE_VIEW "Toggle VWC or Variance View". In variance mode each pin's value is its measured VWC minus its Target VWC, rounded (sa-dash-map.component.ts:317), coloured against three bands. As in the moisture view, pins not scanned today are drawn clear (:318).

claims.text: Use the chart for one area at a time
claims.note: Step title. The chart follows the table's current level; inside an area it offers that area's holes.

claims.text: The chart above the table plots the areas, holes or stations you pick in its multiselect, whichever level the table is showing.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/3/2); docs/text-corrections.md §24 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The chart above the table plots the holes you pick in the multiselect.

claims.text: On screens 1400 px wide or narrower the chart is hidden.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/3/2); docs/text-corrections.md §24 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Selecting a row in the table changes the chart header to that area or hole and its average moisture, so the chart and the table always describe the same thing.
claims.note: Drilling into an area or a hole broadcasts that row to the chart (sa-dash-table.component.ts:338, :414), and the header shows its name and average to two decimals with CASE_SENSITIVE.AVG_MOISTURE_ABBR "AVG. VWC" (sa-dash-chart.component.html:3-4). At the course level the header reads STRINGS.COURSE "Course" (sa-dash-table.component.ts:301-303). Selecting a station row does not change the header.

claims.text: Chart and table share a selection.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The header reads the selected item and its average moisture.
claims.note: Retyped from calculation to behaviour: the header displays a value, it does not compute one. Name, then the average to two decimals labelled CASE_SENSITIVE.AVG_MOISTURE_ABBR "AVG. VWC".

claims.text: Work in the table
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: The table is a drill-down: course, then areas, then holes, then stations.
claims.note: Course level lists areas, an area lists its holes, a hole lists its stations (sa-dash-table.component.ts:268-420), and clicking a row drills down (:108-118). This is the All Stations tab; the Over/Under tab shows a flat station list instead (sa-dashboard.component.html:44-51).

claims.text: Breadcrumbs at the top left take you back up.
claims.note: The first crumb is STRINGS.COURSE "Course" and drilling in adds the area and hole; clicking a crumb navigates back up.

claims.text: At station level you get the editable columns — Target VWC, the current and suggested adjustment side by side, your own % Adj. value, and the Enable switch.
claims.note: Station-level headers are SPATIAL_ADJUST.TARGET_VWC "Target VWC", STRINGS.ADJUSTMENT "Adjustment" over STRINGS.CURRENT "Current" and STRINGS.SUGGESTED "Suggested", SPATIAL_ADJUST.PERCENT_ADJUST_ABBR "% Adj." and STRINGS.ENABLE "Enable" (sa-dash-table.component.html:14-26). Target VWC (0-50) and % Adj. (0-900) are inputs (sa-table-card.component.html:40-62); Current and Suggested are read-only. The Enable switch appears on every level, not only stations (:67-69). On production a station that was not scanned today and has no Option 2 estimate shows "--" in place of the % Adj. input (:51-54).

claims.text: Station-level rows for hole 3 of area AP.
claims.note: Figure caption. The hole and area named are the figure's sample data; at hole level the table lists that hole's stations with the station-level columns.

claims.text: Measured or modelled. A greyed, italic Avg.
claims.note: Read with dashboard-overview/4/7; the sentence splitter cut "Avg. VWC" in two. See that claim's note.

claims.text: VWC with a calculator icon means the value was estimated from the model rather than measured by a scan that day.
claims.note: A row gets class sa-vwc-estimated, drawn dark grey and italic, when the station is estimated: not scanned today while Option 2 is the algorithm (spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:184-188). The calculator icon shows on estimated rows and on parent rows with an estimated child (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31). It is orange on a single estimated station and grey on area, hole and multi-sprinkler rows (sa-table-card.component.less:97-117), as 373-1135 rev 02 §Table Functionality describes. Under Option 1 nothing is estimated and an unscanned station shows "--" (sa-table-card.component.ts:374-375).

claims.text: Check the counts before you leave
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: The right of the toolbar is your work queue.
claims.note: #sa-tb-right holds Push Changes and the Pushed Today counter, followed by the scan-data request, Announcements, Settings and Sign Out buttons.

claims.text: Push Changes counts the enabled stations whose % Adj. differs from what Lynx holds, edited or not, leaving out any already pushed today; the green counter beside it counts stations already pushed today.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/5/3); docs/text-corrections.md §15 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Push Changes counts stations with an unpushed edit, and the green counter beside it counts stations already pushed today.

claims.text: When both are quiet, there is nothing outstanding.
claims.note: "Quiet" means the button carries no number and is disabled, and the counter reads 0. If the button reads "Push Changes" with no number but is still enabled, the pending stations are ones already pushed today (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34, :40), so there is still something to review.

claims.text: Six stations pending, six already pushed today.
claims.note: Figure caption. Sample numbers; the label is CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_N_CHANGES "Push {{ num }} Changes" with the counter beside it.

claims.text: With nothing pending the button is disabled.
claims.note: Disabled while nothing is pending or a push is in progress.

claims.text: The map, chart and table all show the course selected in the toolbar.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §24 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The map, chart and table all name the same course.

claims.text: Calculation ET under the filter tabs is the figure the calculation used.
claims.note: Calculation ET shows the newest stored ET record for the site (SpatialAdjustService.cs:346-352), the record the calculation reads (:2931, GetCurrentEtForOrgAsync :2838-2882). Before SpatialAdjust:StableEtHourLocal, configured to 11 (api/appsettings.json:149), that record is refreshed from the weather service on each read, so early in the day the label can move ahead of the value today's suggestions used. 373-1135 rev 02 §Calculation ET: updated hourly, daily calculations use the 11:00 AM value. The label is ET before the Crop Coefficient is applied, and Option 1 does not use ET at all.

claims.text: The weather strip reports current conditions separately, so do not expect the two to agree.
claims.note: The strip shows the weather overlay's daily ET; Calculation ET is the stored record the server calculates with, before the Crop Coefficient. They come from different calls and need not match.

claims.text: The station count on the All Stations tab is the number of stations in the course.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/verify/4); docs/text-corrections.md §23 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The station count on the All Stations tab matches the number of pins on the map.

claims.text: The map need not match it, because it draws one pin per sprinkler and by default hides disabled stations.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (dashboard-overview/verify/4); docs/text-corrections.md §23 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
